sourceScope: Accès par une échelle sous C4, sol inondé et brosses mécaniques au fond de la salle.
adaptation: Salle inondée sous C4. Les brosses de fond restent décoratives. La position latérale de l’échelle et la lumière sont des choix de composition pour le duel.

files.prompt: Landscape 16:9 side-on 2.5D fighting game environment background asset, empty flooded mechanical water treatment basin beneath Brookhaven Hospital's Otherworld room C4, Leonard's boss chamber from Silent Hill 3 (2003). Oppressive low concrete basement, wet rust-and-black metal walls, broad muddy olive-brown water plane in lower third, low ceiling. Dirty broken horizontal highlights reflect the sparse distant light; deep background contains partly submerged cylindrical industrial brush rollers at one end, enclosed in grime and shadow. Widescreen continuous side-facing view made for two fighters to be composited, ample empty walkable water in silhouette area, lower foreground water clear, no ladder in background. Atmospheric authentic PS2 material palette with detailed painterly texture in high resolution; enough light across midground to read brutal damp surfaces. No person, no animal, no shadow creatures, no lettering, no overlays, no borders, no logo, no furniture, no swimming pool tiles.

A single old fixed iron access ladder section emerging from dark murky water, isolated parallax scenery prop from below room C4 in Silent Hill 3's rusted hospital basement. Genuine transparent background and negative space between the dark steel rungs. Entire object, vertical narrow view in slight three-quarter profile, two long parallel grimy upright rails with six welded horizontal rungs, rough olive and brown oxidation, small drops and wet glints under faint diffuse cellar light; bottom ends worn and blackened, straight side rails both continue to top. Isolate the ladder, no water surface, no wall, no terrain, no floodlight, no people, no text or UI. Downstage far-left edge parallax prop in side-scrolling horror fighting game, realistically textured PS2 survival-horror art, no graphic outlines.
